Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike gains support, draws political and celebrity attention

Activist Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike, now in its 19th day, has garnered significant attention. Political figures, including Arvind Kejriwal, have invoked past protest movements to express solidarity. Bollywood celebrities and comedians have also joined in, urging the government to engage in dialogue as the strike enters a critical phase.
